# 8:45 post-data check, Tue Nov 3 2026 (~8:55 AM ET) - PMH breaks on Iran deal headlines, message sent

- Data: no 8:30 release today. Next up: 10:00 JOLTS (fcst 7.15M, prior 7.08M) and factory orders; election results tonight; AMD after the close.
- The news (Financial Juice): 8:26 Al Araby Al Jadeed, citing sources, says Washington and Tehran made concessions on the nuclear program and frozen funds; 8:36 Washington has approved the draft memorandum of understanding; 8:42-8:45 talks now on how to announce an interim agreement, "step by step and simultaneously." Unconfirmed single-source reports. Also: 8:19-8:21 UKMTO reports a vessel attacked near the Hormuz exit (crew rescued by Oman); 8:20 Trump on Fox says the US hit an Iranian facility last night; 8:17 Iran's armed forces chief threatens an unlimited response; 8:05 Energy Sec. Wright says the strikes haven't hit oil flow; 8:39 Zelenskiy confirms a Ukraine-Russia-US meeting in Abu Dhabi Nov 10-11; 8:12 Meta five-part bond deal.
- Futures since 8:00 (yfinance 1m, last ~8:42): NQ 28,333 vs 28,227 (+0.38%), high 28,426.5 (+0.7%) then faded about 95 pts. ES 7,588 vs 7,569 (+0.25%), high 7,604.75. RTY 2,833.4 (+0.52%), high 2,841.6. VIX 20.81 (-2.4%, low 20.52). 10y 4.91% (from 4.93%). DXY 101.77. WTI 94.72 (-2.6%, low 93.59).
- ETFs (~8:52): all three broke their 8:00 pre-market highs.
  - SPY 753.66; high 755.15 cleared the 752.41 PMH and the 751.6 PDL, stalled just under the 755.5 dark pool. New PM range 749.38-755.15.
  - QQQ 686.31; high 688.25 cleared the 684.56 PMH and the 686 sign change. New PM range 678.99-688.25.
  - IWM 280.77; high 281.48 cleared the 279.57 PMH and tagged the 281-281.5 dark pool. New PM range 277.99-281.48.
- GEX re-pull (Quant Data API, ~8:53): SPY net -4.60B (8:05 -4.35B), put walls 740/730/725, call walls 800/780/770, sign changes 750-751 and 758. QQQ net -3.46B (from -2.77B), put walls 680/675/685, call walls 725/750/715, sign changes 683-686 (spot is right on them). IWM net +0.02B, call 285/290/284, put 275/260/280, sign change 281. Still negative gamma in SPY/QQQ, walls and magnets unchanged.
- 9,000+ contract prints today (Quant Data unconsolidated order flow): 0 rows.
- Read: a headline-driven pop through the pre-market highs on the Iran deal reports and falling oil, already partly faded (NQ gave back about half). Negative gamma means dealers chase moves, so a confirmed deal could extend it and a denial could reverse it fast. Under Casey's rules the PM range is now wider and is still a no-trade zone until a 15-min close outside it after 9:45. Upside targets: SPY 755.5-756 then 758, QQQ 690.5, IWM 281.5-282. Downside: SPY 751.6-752.4 is now support, then 749.4-750; QQQ 683.5-684.5, then 679-681; IWM 279-279.6.
